note_on_stream_ids: eligible_stream_ids values must match an 'id' inside data/curriculum_subjects.json's curricula[curriculum].streams[].id (stream-based curricula, e.g. Indian's 'science-pcmb') or .groups[].id (group-based curricula, e.g. IB's 'group4'). An empty array means the question applies to every stream/group within that curriculum. Curricula with no stream/group structure (the curriculum_subjects.json 'Other' bucket) should always use an empty array here.
